title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 抗议、身体与数据边界：绿色经济、移民拘押、性别暴力、艺术记忆与AI风险
sourcePolicy: 本期仅采用用户指定来源池中可核验发布日期与原文链接的报道；8条来源均为 The Guardian。正文采用直接叙述，来源统一列于文末。
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：“protest, bodies, and data boundaries（抗议、身体与数据边界）”。绿色经济被量化为就业与产业，移民拘押引发街头抗议，性别暴力和医疗忽视继续进入公共讨论，艺术在追索失踪者与重估作品归属，而 AI 风险则落在账号安全、儿童保护和国家数据边界上。

items.title: 英国绿色经济年价值超过1000亿英镑：气候转型成为产业现实
items.summaryChinese: 最新研究估算，英国净零产业每年价值超过1000亿英镑，相关就业超过100万个，并且收益分布到全国多个地区。气候政策常被说成成本或约束，但这类数据把它重新放进产业、就业和地方经济的框架里。绿色转型不只是环保议题，也是在决定未来哪些地区、技能和劳动会被投资。
items.correspondingEnglish: New research estimates that the UK’s net zero economy is worth more than £100bn a year and supports over one million jobs. The findings place climate policy inside a wider debate about industry, employment and regional development. The green transition is not only an environmental issue. It is also a question of where investment, skills and future work will go.

englishExpressions.example: The green economy is becoming a major source of jobs.
Net zero industry can support regional development.
Regional development depends on where new investment flows.

items.studyNote: worth more than... a year 是财经新闻常见结构，用来表达某行业或市场的年度规模。

items.title: 新泽西ICE拘押设施外抗议持续：拘押制度进入街头政治
items.summaryChinese: 新泽西 Delaney Hall 移民拘押设施外的冲突持续，数名抗议者被捕。现场抗议与设施内的绝食和劳动行动相互呼应，凸显移民拘押不是封闭在建筑里的行政程序，而是会牵动社区、劳工、健康条件和警察权力的公共议题。一个拘押中心既是边境政策的延伸，也是城市中的政治现场。
items.correspondingEnglish: Several protesters were arrested outside the Delaney Hall ICE facility in New Jersey as clashes continued. The protests followed reports of hunger and labor strikes inside the facility. Immigration detention is not only an administrative process hidden inside a building. It connects border policy with community politics, working conditions, health and policing.

englishExpressions.example: Protests continued outside the detention facility.
A hunger strike drew attention to conditions inside the facility.
Border policy can reshape local community life.

items.studyNote: facility 是新闻中很常见的模糊词，可以指设施、机构、中心；具体含义要看前面的限定词。

items.title: 曼彻斯特大学调查女医学生遭性骚扰：校园安全与专业权力
items.summaryChinese: 曼彻斯特大学启动调查，约20名女医学生报告称，她们深夜接到匿名男性电话，对方以羞辱、恐吓和贬低的方式骚扰她们。医学教育通常被想象为高度专业化的训练空间，但这起事件提醒我们，性骚扰会穿过校园、宿舍、电话和职业等级结构，让学习环境变成不安全的空间。
items.correspondingEnglish: The University of Manchester is investigating reports that about 20 female medical students received anonymous late-night calls from men who allegedly intimidated, demeaned and belittled them. Medical education is often imagined as a professional training space, but harassment can move through phones, campuses and hierarchies, turning learning environments into unsafe spaces.

englishExpressions.example: The university opened an investigation into sexual harassment.
A safe learning environment is essential for students.
Professional hierarchy can make complaints harder to raise.

items.studyNote: intimidate, demean and belittle 三个动词层层递进，分别指恐吓、贬低人格、轻视羞辱。

items.title: 伊拉克少女拒绝强迫婚姻后被杀：家庭暴力如何被文化合理化
items.summaryChinese: 一名15岁伊拉克少女因拒绝与表亲结婚而被杀害。她的一名女性亲属讲述了事件经过，并表达对其他被迫早婚女孩的担忧。这个故事最沉重的部分在于，暴力不只是一个人的行为，也可能被家族、习俗和沉默共同支撑。当身体自主被剥夺，婚姻就不再是家庭事务，而是人权问题。
items.correspondingEnglish: A 15-year-old girl in Iraq was killed after refusing to marry her cousin. A female relative described what happened and voiced fears for other girls forced into early marriage. The most painful part is that violence can be supported by family approval, custom and silence. When bodily autonomy is denied, marriage is no longer a private family matter. It becomes a human rights issue.

englishExpressions.example: Forced marriage violates bodily autonomy.
Bodily autonomy means having control over one’s own body.
Family approval can sometimes hide coercion.

items.studyNote: bodily autonomy 是性别与人权写作中的核心表达，常用于婚姻、生育、医疗和性暴力议题。

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: 卢西安·弗洛伊德早期肖像首次展出：艺术归属也需要证据
items.summaryChinese: 一幅曾被卢西安·弗洛伊德本人否认的早期肖像《黑围巾男子》，在新的证据支持下被认证为其学生时代作品，并首次公开展出。艺术史并不是一条已经固定的时间线，它也会因档案、技术鉴定和市场机制而被改写。谁画了这幅画，关系到的不只是作者名字，也包括价值、记忆和权威。
items.correspondingEnglish: An early portrait once denied by Lucian Freud has been authenticated and shown publicly for the first time. New evidence suggests that Man in a Black Scarf was painted while Freud was a student. Art history is not a fixed timeline. It can be rewritten by archives, technical examination and the art market. Authorship shapes value, memory and authority.

englishExpressions.example: Art authentication can change a painting’s history and value.
The early portrait was shown for the first time.
Authorship matters in both art history and the market.

items.studyNote: authorship 不只是“作者”，还包括作品归属、责任、权威和解释权。

items.title: 西班牙家庭寻找佛朗哥镇压中失踪的父亲：摄影作为创伤档案
items.summaryChinese: 摄影记者 Roberto Palomo 用五年时间追索曾祖父在佛朗哥镇压中失踪的经历，记录遗骸寻找、身份确认和创伤记忆如何影响后代。这样的摄影不是简单再现过去，而是把家庭沉默、国家暴力和代际记忆放在同一个画面里。照片让失踪者重新拥有位置，也让历史不再只属于官方档案。
items.correspondingEnglish: Photojournalist Roberto Palomo spent five years tracing the story of his great-grandfather, who disappeared during Francoist repression. The project documents the search for remains, the process of recovery and the effects of traumatic memory on descendants. Photography here is not just a record of the past. It gives the disappeared a place in the present.

englishExpressions.example: Traumatic memory can shape families across generations.
The photo essay follows a family’s search for answers.
Personal testimony can challenge the official archive.

items.studyNote: the disappeared 常用于拉美、西班牙等政治暴力语境，指被国家或武装力量强迫失踪的人。

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: 黑客利用Meta AI客服机器人入侵高关注账号：自动化客服变成安全入口
items.summaryChinese: 黑客诱骗 Meta 的 AI 支持机器人，入侵包括奥巴马白宫 Instagram 账号在内的高关注账户。事件暴露一个新风险：当平台把密码、身份验证和账号恢复交给自动化系统，攻击者也会寻找自动化流程中的漏洞。AI 不只是聊天工具，它正在成为数字安全链条的一环，任何一环失守都会放大风险。
items.correspondingEnglish: Hackers tricked Meta’s AI support bot and infiltrated high-profile Instagram accounts, including an Obama White House account. The breach raises concerns about using AI in security processes such as passwords and account recovery. AI is not only a chat tool. It is becoming part of the digital security chain, and weak points in that chain can amplify risk.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 客服机器人；支持机器人
englishExpressions.example: A support bot can become a target for attackers.
Account recovery systems must be protected from abuse.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 安全漏洞；安全入侵事件
englishExpressions.example: The security breach affected high-profile accounts.

items.studyNote: breach 可以指数据泄露、安全入侵，也可以指违反协议或法律。

items.title: 佛州起诉OpenAI：儿童安全成为AI产品责任焦点
items.summaryChinese: 佛罗里达州起诉 OpenAI 及其首席执行官，指控公司忽视安全警告，让可能危及儿童的产品进入数百万用户手中。OpenAI 面对的争议说明，AI 产品责任已经不只是“模型是否好用”，而是包括未成年人保护、风险提示、企业内部警告是否被重视，以及监管者如何界定伤害。
items.correspondingEnglish: Florida sued OpenAI and its chief executive, alleging that the company ignored safety warnings and allowed a dangerous product to reach millions of users. The dispute shows that AI product responsibility is no longer only about whether a model works well. It also includes child safety, risk warnings, internal accountability and how regulators define harm.

englishExpressions.example: The lawsuit says safety warnings were ignored.
Child safety is becoming central to AI regulation.
AI companies face growing questions about product responsibility.

items.studyNote: product responsibility 比 product safety 更宽，既包括安全，也包括设计、警示、监管和损害责任。

englishParagraph.english: Today’s news shows that systems become political when they decide whose body, data or memory is protected. A green economy is measured in jobs and investment. A detention facility turns border policy into local protest. Harassment and forced marriage reveal how power enters intimate life. Art can reopen disputed histories, while AI systems now affect security, childhood and corporate accountability.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻让我们看到，当一个系统决定谁的身体、数据或记忆受到保护时，它就变成了政治问题。绿色经济被就业和投资衡量；拘押设施把边境政策变成地方抗议；性骚扰和强迫婚姻揭示权力如何进入亲密生活；艺术能够重新打开有争议的历史，而 AI 系统如今已经影响安全、儿童保护和企业问责。

keywords.meaning: 绿色经济；以低碳、环保和可持续产业为核心的经济活动
keywords.example: The green economy can create jobs across different regions.

keywords.meaning: 拘押设施；用于关押或临时拘留人员的机构
keywords.example: Protesters gathered outside the detention facility.

keywords.meaning: 身体自主权；个人对自身身体和选择的控制权
keywords.example: Forced marriage is a violation of bodily autonomy.

keywords.meaning: 作者身份；作品归属与解释权
keywords.example: Authorship can change how a painting is valued.

keywords.meaning: 安全入侵；安全漏洞事件
keywords.example: A security breach exposed weaknesses in account recovery.

keywords.meaning: 产品责任；企业对产品风险、伤害和设计后果承担的责任
keywords.example: AI product responsibility includes child safety and warnings.

sentenceLab.sentence: Systems become political when they decide whose body, data or memory is protected.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: 这个句子用 become political 表达“进入政治领域 / 具有权力后果”。whose body, data or memory is protected 是宾语从句中的名词性结构，强调保护对象本身就体现权力分配。

reflection.english: Protection is never neutral when some people must fight to be included in it.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：当有些人必须努力争取才会被保护时，保护本身就从来不是中性的。
